text:
Jen H.: Heads-up — PR #4823 updates the private/on-prem install guide and adds a rollback section. Need a quick pass on KMS/HSM steps + a tiny SDK fallback example.

Omar R.: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Also saw a broken link to the cert-chain page. Docs-bot reported 2 dead links.

Docs Bot: link-checker: found 2 broken targets in PR #4823 -> /docs/private/kms-legacy (404), /docs/hsm/pkcs11-old (404).

Alex P.: I can review KMS steps. Can we add an explicit emergency rollback command example for on-prem? Suggest inline example: `rwinfctl rollback --to-version v2026.02 --force` (note: runs db migration revert if available).

Maria L.: Also include systemd restore steps, e.g.: `sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference && tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/v2026.02.tgz -C /opt/redwood && sudo systemctl start redwood-inference` and mention graceful restart caveat.

Omar R.: Good call. I'll add both snippets. Also adding HSM ACL note: remind operators to verify PKCS#11 slot mapping after rollback.

Jen H.: Can you add an SDK snippet showing switching to a local fallback KMS in air-gapped installs? Something tiny for Python + env var example.

Omar R.: Draft snippet: ```python
from rwinf_sdk import Client
client = Client(config={"kms": "local", "kms_path": "/var/lib/local-kms/keys"})
# fallback to local KMS in airgapped mode
``` Is that okay or too hand-wavy?

Alex P.: That's fine but prefer showing env var approach too: `export RW_KMS=local; export RW_KMS_PATH=/var/lib/local-kms/keys` then `Client()` picks it up. Add note: test in a non-prod VPC.

Maria L.: Migration note: after rollback clear the KV cache to avoid stale model metadata: `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix model:` — include this as a blocker for rollbacks.

Jen H.: Small docs nit: change wording from "restart service" -> "graceful-restart service" and call out expected downtime window (~60s). Fix the two dead links (replace with /docs/private/kms and /docs/hsm/pkcs11).

Omar R.: Will push edits in ~30m and ping here. Adding @Alex P. for KMS verification step. :thumbsup:

Alex P.: On it, I'll run smoke tests in a detached VPC and confirm the PKCS#11 mapping.

Jen H.: Thanks team — merge once CI/link-checker green and Alex thumbs up. :shipit:
